entities.name: Joseph J. Tyson

entities.summary: Joseph Jude Tyson is an American Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Yakima in Washington State since 2011. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Seattle in Washington State from 2005 to 2011.
